groups.name: Time and session semantics
groups.definition: Canonical/market-local time, trading date, session phase and source vintage state.
groups.exclude: Exclude availability/quality scoring and option-expiry arithmetic.

groups.name: L1 quotes and trade direction
groups.definition: Best bid/ask prices and size imbalance; trade-sign inference and signed traded volume.
groups.exclude: Exclude market-depth reconstruction and order-book event dynamics.

groups.name: Price path and VWAP
groups.definition: Underlying price returns, gaps, VWAP, price location and VWAP momentum.
groups.exclude: Exclude provider-to-system data-integrity comparison D018.

groups.name: Volume and trade activity
groups.definition: Relative volume and standardized trading-volume/trade-rate activity.
groups.exclude: Exclude options-chain volume/open-interest analytics.

groups.name: Realised volatility and range
groups.definition: Return-based realised volatility, jump variation and bar true range.
groups.exclude: Exclude implied volatility surfaces, VIX-family indices and composite regimes.

groups.name: Trend and reversion features
groups.definition: Composite trend strength and mean-reversion features of the underlying.
groups.exclude: Exclude pure returns, VWAP changes, and volatility estimates.

groups.name: Rates and funding spreads
groups.definition: Yield-curve slopes and rate, inflation-expectation and funding-spread changes.
groups.exclude: Exclude composite macro latent-factor inference.

groups.name: Foreign-exchange changes
groups.definition: Observed broad-dollar and bilateral currency changes over specified windows.
groups.exclude: Exclude country equity-index returns and combined international scores.

groups.name: Volatility indices and regimes
groups.definition: Cboe volatility-index changes, term slopes and volatility-index-based composite regime score.
groups.exclude: Exclude NVDA options IV surface and realised-volatility estimation.

groups.name: Scheduled-event state
groups.definition: Time-to-event, release surprise, event importance and active-event-window measures.
groups.exclude: Exclude prospective trade gating, candidate utility and strategy decisions.

groups.name: International equity context
groups.definition: Non-US index returns and aggregated international overnight risk condition.
groups.exclude: Exclude FX-only transformations already assigned to FX.

groups.name: US market and cross-market breadth
groups.definition: US market proxy returns, NVDA-market/sector correlations, return dispersion and monitored-basket breadth.
groups.exclude: Exclude sector-relative/rotation composite calculations.

groups.name: Technology and semiconductor sector
groups.definition: Sector ETF returns, technology/semiconductor relative strength and rotation state.
groups.exclude: Exclude NVDA-specific residual return or estimated beta.

groups.name: NVDA factor-relative state
groups.definition: NVDA underlying return, conditional market/sector beta and residual stock-specific return.
groups.exclude: Exclude sector ETF or broad index return series.

groups.name: Option expiry and moneyness
groups.definition: Option time-to-expiry, spot/log moneyness and standard delta-category placement.
groups.exclude: Exclude quoted premiums, spreads and implied volatility.

groups.name: Option quote liquidity
groups.definition: Option premium midpoint, spread, displayed nearby depth and combined liquidity score.
groups.exclude: Exclude full book reconstruction and execution-price action.

groups.name: Implied-volatility surface and fit
groups.definition: Quoted implied-volatility measures, changes, term structure, skew, smile, fit error and IV rank/percentile.
groups.exclude: Exclude realised-vol comparisons and probability distributions.

groups.name: Data quality and reconciliation
groups.definition: Staleness, required-field coverage, cross-source temporal alignment, independent VWAP cross-check and composite data quality.
groups.exclude: Exclude market price/return and fitted IV-surface error.

groups.name: Option-implied move proxy
groups.definition: ATM straddle mid-premium and premium-to-spot implied movement proxy.
groups.exclude: Exclude calibrated probability densities/tail probabilities.

groups.name: Option probability distributions
groups.definition: Risk-neutral density and tails; conditional physical return density.
groups.exclude: Exclude straddle premium proxies and comparisons between distributions.

groups.name: IV and probability relative value
groups.definition: Implied-versus-realised volatility gaps and risk-neutral versus physical distribution disagreement.
groups.exclude: Exclude generating the underlying probability distributions.

groups.name: Option volume and open interest
groups.definition: Option volume/OI ratios, abnormal activity, call/put mixes, OI change and OI concentration.
groups.exclude: Exclude signed aggressive option order flow and dealer-side inference.

groups.name: Signed option order flow
groups.definition: Signed option trades and aggregated flow by delta bucket or expiry.
groups.exclude: Exclude public-volume/OI measures without signed initiator information.

groups.name: Inferred dealer exposures
groups.definition: Dealer-position-assumption-dependent Greek OI proxies, gamma zones/flips and hedge-pressure scenarios.
groups.exclude: Exclude directly observed option volume/OI and measured account holdings.

groups.name: L2 book depth and dynamics
groups.definition: SMART/direct book depth, imbalance, microprice, dynamics, venue structure and OFI.
groups.exclude: Exclude top-of-book best-quote arithmetic and candidate order pricing.

groups.name: Latent macro risk factors
groups.definition: Growth, inflation, policy, funding and global latent market-factor synthesis.
groups.exclude: Exclude direct rate/FX transformations and probability vectors.

groups.name: Probabilistic regime inference
groups.definition: Estimated probabilities of dominant market drivers and NVDA underlying/options regimes.
groups.exclude: Exclude deterministic source summaries and decision gate outputs.

groups.name: State assembly and coherence
groups.definition: Assembled market-state vector, redundancy and signal conflict measures, and state identifiability/readiness.
groups.exclude: Exclude source quality tests and explicit allow/no-trade policy decisions.

groups.name: Joint scenario generation
groups.definition: Probability-weighted conditional joint future-market scenario paths.
groups.exclude: Exclude candidate valuation and structure-specific scenario stress matrices.

groups.name: Candidate valuation and risk metrics
groups.definition: Candidate slippage and total execution-cost estimates, expected P&L, tail risk, aggregate Greeks, payoff loss, breakevens and stress losses.
groups.exclude: Exclude utility preferences, ranked selection, allowable risk limits and order placement decisions.

groups.name: Candidate decision scoring and selection
groups.definition: Uncertainty/utility penalties, candidate utility, trade/no-trade eligibility and exposure/strike/expiry preference scoring/selection.
groups.exclude: Exclude purely measured candidate loss, market-state identifiability and permissible position risk.

groups.name: Risk limits and position sizing
groups.definition: Permissible capital/tail/concentration risk bounds and candidate position sizing.
groups.exclude: Exclude raw account balance, observed Greeks and action-state logic.

groups.name: Pretrade execution and order pricing
groups.definition: Refreshed net entry edge and proposed limit-price target for intended execution.
groups.exclude: Exclude predicted transaction costs, observed fills and realised costs.

groups.name: Execution outcomes and realised costs
groups.definition: Post-submission fill slippage/completion and measured realised transaction costs.
groups.exclude: Exclude proposed limit prices and prospective cost estimates.

groups.name: Live portfolio exposures and P&L
groups.definition: Observed live portfolio Greek aggregates and portfolio realised/unrealised P&L state.
groups.exclude: Exclude action policy, hedging decisions and retrospective attribution.

groups.name: Live position assessment and decisions
groups.definition: Entry-state comparison, invalidation, continuation/modification/exit valuation, hedge needs and hold/modify/exit decision.
groups.exclude: Exclude measured live portfolio Greeks and post-trade realised attribution.

groups.name: Post-trade P&L attribution
groups.definition: Breakdown of observed position P&L by delta/gamma/vega/theta/skew and residual.
groups.exclude: Exclude decision/process quality and alternative-path counterfactuals.

groups.name: Decision review and counterfactuals
groups.definition: Decision-process quality, no-trade/alternative counterfactuals and out-of-sample decision performance.
groups.exclude: Exclude raw P&L attribution and probabilistic calibration measures.

groups.name: Forecast and signal validation
groups.definition: Incremental signal information, probability calibration/proper scores, drift and signal disposition.
groups.exclude: Exclude realised position P&L attribution and next-update scheduling.

groups.name: Observation and recalculation scheduling
groups.definition: The event or schedule trigger for the next observe/calculate iteration.
groups.exclude: Exclude market-data timestamps and financial signal transformations.
